remarks: NORWALK SINGLE-FAMILY UNDER $400,000 - BRING YOUR CONTRACTOR & YOUR VISION! Opportunity awaits at this 2-bedroom, 1-bath Cape offering 832 square feet of living space, an attached garage, unfinished basement and walk-up attic with potential for additional living space. This home is a true fixer-upper and needs substantial renovation, but for the buyer with vision, it offers an exciting opportunity to transform and reimagine the space. The walk-up attic provides particularly interesting possibilities for future expansion, subject to buyer due diligence and applicable approvals. Set on a .15-acre lot in Norwalk, the property is being offered AS-IS and is priced with its condition in mind. Bring your contractor, your ideas and your imagination! Not a move-in-ready property.
